name: Typecho
description: Typecho is a lightweight, open-source PHP blogging platform with a Markdown editor, pages, categories and tags, threaded comments, themes, plugins and an XML-RPC API for desktop and mobile editors.

app_vars.name: var_admin_pass
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: Generated when empty. Shown at the end of the install output either way.

notes.text: After the first login at http://<IP>/admin/, replace the placeholder email address admin@localhost.local in your profile.
Typecho builds every link from the site address http://<container IP>. Change it under Settings > Basic when the IP changes or the blog sits behind a reverse proxy or domain.
After an update, open /admin/ and confirm the database upgrade Typecho asks for.
